proposals.evidence: DEDR 5450 full article (p. 495) gives Kor. (T.) bī- to grind. Te. vīcu to blow as the wind; wave ( tr. ), (K. also) fling, throw with a sweep, fan; vī-tencu to blow as the wind; vīcōpu chowrie; vīvana fan, whisk; vīvali wind; visan Bhat bī “to grind” matches Lindgren Koraga bī “grind” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
